pages.title: Onboarding
pages.text: Practice pages for new editors live here. Type /claim-tagger-walkthrough in Claude Code and give this page's link; nothing on a practice page touches the real Claims table.

hub.title: Claim tagger
hub.note: Claims is the real table: every decision you make there trains the rulebook. To practise, open Onboarding.

databases.title: Claims
databases.description: 200 Geo claims tagged Debate. Decide them through Your queue; every decision trains the rulebook.

text.content: 200 Geo claims tagged Debate. Decide them through Your queue; every decision trains the rulebook.

Agent confidence.description: How sure the agent is: the lowest confidence among the tags it judged on the claim, from 0.5 (a coin flip) to 1 (certain). Your queue is sorted by it, lowest first.

Agent reasons.description: Why the agent proposed what it did: one line per judged tag, "<Tag>: <reason> · <rule cited> · <k> of <n> runs agree", so you can decide without opening the agent's record.

Agent status.description: What the agent says about the claim: Waits for you (a tag needs your decision), Done, Disagrees with your decision, or Could not read. Your queue lists Waits for you until you set Review status to Reviewed.

Agent edition.description: The rulebook edition the agent wrote this row under.

Agent remarks.description: What the agent could not check, such as "not checked: 6 tags without rules"; empty when it checked everything.

Agent reading.description: What the agent made of your decision, one line per tag where you differed from it: Agent slip, Rule unclear or Rule should change, the rule, and why. Empty until the agent has read your decision.

Review status.description: To review or Reviewed. A claim is decided once it is Reviewed; anything else leaves it open. Set it last: the claim leaves Your queue as soon as it is Reviewed.

Challenged tags notes.description: Your words. A line that starts with a tag name and a colon belongs to that tag. Open it with Agent slip, Rule unclear or Rule should change and a full stop to say what you think went wrong; otherwise the agent reads it. "rule 4" names the rule.

Geo ID.description: The claim's identity in Geo; the queue's Key starts with it.

Geo Space.description: The Geo space the claim was read from.

Geo Created.description: The day the claim was made in Geo.

Geo Sources.description: The claim's sources, as Geo lists them.

Geo Is factual.description: Ticked when Geo marks the claim as factual.

databases.title: Rulebook
databases.description: One row per tag; When to use holds the rules. Change rules through Lessons waiting.

text.content: One row per tag; When to use holds the rules. Change rules through Lessons waiting.

Name.description: The tag's name; one row per tag.

Counterpart.description: The opposite tag it pairs with (Self-contained for Context-dependent).

Description.description: One or two sentences describing a claim that carries the tag.

Evidence.description: The report the tag's verification rests on.

Example Claims.description: Claims that show the tag, one per line.

Geo Status.description: Whether the tag exists in Geo.

Polarity.description: Kept as in the taxonomy; the agent does not use it.

When to use.description: The numbered rules the agent applies; a tag is judged only when this holds rules.

Work tags.description: The work the tag belongs to; every row here has Issue.

databases.title: Rule changes
databases.description: Rule changes the agent drafted. The rule owner sets Approved or Rejected.

text.content: Rule changes the agent drafted. The rule owner sets Approved or Rejected.

Lesson.description: A short name for the change.

Tag.description: The tag the change is about.

Safety check result.description: For example "PASS: examples 11/11, earlier 10/10, yours 2/2" or "FAIL: 'Excluding CNN from Air Force One violates the federal court order' now Does not apply".

Supporting rows.description: One line per decided row the change rests on: the claim shortened, " · ", the row's Key.

Editor wording.description: The rule as the editor words it; when filled, the safety check tests it instead of the Proposed text. Never written by the agent.

Status.description: The editor sets Approved and Rejected; the agent sets Proposed, Live and Rolled back.

databases.title: Tag decisions
databases.description: The agent's record, copied from Claims. Read only; never edit here.

text.content: The agent's record, copied from Claims. Read only; never edit here.

Key.description: The claim's Geo ID, two colons, the tag; one row per claim and tag.

Tag.description: The tag the row is about.

Agent confidence.description: How sure the agent is of its answer, from 0.5 (a coin flip) to 1 (certain); the queue is sorted by it, lowest first.

Agent reason.description: At most 40 words, then the rule cited and how many runs agreed.

Claim link.description: Link to the claim's row in the Claims table.

Rulebook edition.description: The edition the proposal was made under.

Follow-up.description: Set after a safety check PASS, on the rows the change rests on.

Tag outcome.description: Copied by the agent from the claim once an editor has Reviewed it: Applies when the tag is in Verified tags, else Does not apply.

Why wrong.description: Copied by the agent from your note on the claim: the reason word that opens the tag's line (Agent slip, Rule unclear or Rule should change), for a tag whose outcome differs from the proposal.

Your reasoning.description: Copied by the agent from Challenged tags notes: the tag's own line, else the whole text.

Decided under.description: The edition the proposal you saw was made under, recorded when the agent copies your decision from the claim.

Agent reading.description: What the agent made of your decision where you differed from it: Agent slip (the rule settles it your way), Rule unclear (it reads both ways) or Rule should change (it decides against you). Written by the agent.

Rule.description: The rule the reading points at, for example "Context-dependent rule 3".

Reading note.description: One line of why. It opens with "without your note" when you wrote nothing for the tag.

Read under.description: The edition and a short mark of what the reading rests on: your decision, your note and the proposal the agent made. The agent reads a row again only when one of those changes.

databases.title: Agent settings
databases.description: Tick Paused to stop every command; untick to resume.

text.content: Tick Paused to stop every command; untick to resume.

Paused.description: Ticked by a person, every command then refuses; cleared by a person.

Rulebook edition.description: The edition in force: a date plus a count, such as 2026-10-16.1; it goes up when a rule changes.

Last run summary.description: One short line, such as "Promote · 16 Oct 11:20 · PASS".
